whoosh: a quick short air whoosh, a fast camera whip pan, dry, no music
shatter: an old painted plaster panel cracks and shatters into pieces that clatter onto a wooden floor, dry room
stamp: a loud heavy rubber stamp slammed down on a wooden desk, one sharp thud
curtain: a heavy velvet theatre curtain swooshing down quickly
tear: a sheet of thick paper torn quickly in one long rip
flip: a stiff card flipped over quickly on a table, one soft flap
